ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Project delivery, On site and later stages need Start on site, RAMS approved and Insurance verified.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Pre-start", 1, "Mobilising", 2, "On site", 3, "Snagging", 4, "Defects period", 5, "Closed out", 6, 0) >= 3, OR(ISBLANK(Start_on_site_date__c), NOT(Rams_approved__c), NOT(Insurance_verified__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Start on site, RAMS approved and Insurance verified before moving to On site.
